rules.title: Missing Parent Link
rules.description: Required parent (pack/module/concept parent) missing for specialization/inheritance.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if inheritance/specialization declared without parent target.

rules.title: Invalid Parent Reference
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if parent_id not in manifests/registries.
rules.recommended_resolution: Fix parent ID or mark planned with notes.

rules.title: Invalid Child Reference
rules.description: Declared child ID does not resolve.
rules.detection_rule: WARN/FAIL policy: WARN if planned; ERROR if claimed official.
rules.recommended_resolution: Correct child ID or defer until authored.

rules.title: Missing Academic Layer
rules.description: classification.academic_layer missing when required by pack policy.
rules.detection_rule: WARN if academic_layer blank for Pack 01 concepts.

rules.title: Missing Computational Layer
rules.recommended_resolution: Declare computational layer (e.g. Base Knowledge Node).

rules.title: Ontology Layer Conflict
rules.description: Academic and computational layers contradict pack architecture.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if layer pair violates pack layer matrix.
rules.recommended_resolution: Align layers with PACK design architecture.

rules.title: Ontology Consistency Mismatch
rules.description: Declared type inconsistent with template family / graph node.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if Foundational Concept ≠ Concept node, etc.

rules.title: Duplicate Canonical Concept Node
rules.description: Two Concept nodes share one record_id or canonical key.

rules.title: Pack Used As Concept Identity
rules.description: Pack/Module ID used where Concept KR-* required.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if concept slot filled with PACK_*/module_id only.
rules.recommended_resolution: Use KR-* for concepts; Pack/Module are organizational.

rules.title: Invalid Hierarchy Path
rules.detection_rule: WARN if hierarchy_path contradicts classification IDs.
rules.recommended_resolution: Rebuild hierarchy path from canon tree.

rules.title: Orphan Ontology Node
rules.description: Node has no pack/module and no relationships.
rules.detection_rule: WARN if isolated from package and graph.
rules.recommended_resolution: Attach to Pack and declare relationships.

rules.title: Example Without Parent Concept
rules.description: Example node lacks REFERENCES/RELATED_TO parent KR.
rules.detection_rule: WARN if Example has no parent link.

rules.title: Unknown Edge Type In Ontology Context
rules.description: Edge type not in ontology edge registry.
rules.recommended_resolution: Use FOUNDATIONAL_FOR, DEPENDS_ON, CLASSIFIES, REFERENCES, SUPPORTED_BY, RELATED_TO, CONFLICTS_WITH, IMPLEMENTS.
